newsitem.title: IRAN: Another quake hits devastated Iran region - agency.
newsitem.headline: Another quake hits devastated Iran region - agency.

text.p: Another earthquake hit Iran's devastated region of Qaen two days after a huge tremor killed some 2,400 people, Iran's official news agency said on Tuesday.
The second quake late on Monday measured 4.8 on the Richter scale, compared with Saturday's 7.1 magnitude quake.
There was no word of casualties from the latest quake, which struck at 8:58 pm (1628 GMT).
The agency said the Geophysics Institute of Tehran University registered the epicentre 850 km (530 miles) southeast of the base, in the vicinity of Qaen.
About 200 villages near Qaen, in Iran's northeastern province of Khorasan, were levelled by the earlier quake.
Nearly 200 aftershocks have hit Qaen and the nearby town of Birjand with magnitudes ranging from 3.0 to 5.5 since Saturday, IRNA added.
